title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
text: Actively manage all end-user devices, network devices, and servers so that unauthorized or unmanaged assets are identified and remediated.

title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
text: Actively manage all software installed on the network so unauthorized or unmanaged software is found and removed or approved.

title: Data Protection
text: Develop processes to identify, classify, securely handle, retain, and dispose of data based on its sensitivity.

title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
text: Establish and maintain secure configurations for assets and software, disabling unnecessary services and ports.

title: Account Management
text: Use processes and tools to assign and manage authorization for enterprise accounts, including administrator accounts.

title: Access Control Management
text: Use processes and tools to create, assign, manage, and revoke access credentials and privileges.

title: Continuous Vulnerability Management
text: Develop a plan to continuously assess and track vulnerabilities on all enterprise assets, remediating in a risk-based manner.

title: Audit Log Management
text: Collect, alert on, review, and retain audit logs of events that could help detect, understand, or recover from an attack.

title: Email and Web Browser Protections
text: Improve protections and detection of threats delivered through email and web browsers, both common exploitation targets.

title: Malware Defenses
text: Prevent or control the installation, spread, and execution of malicious applications, code, or scripts on enterprise assets.

title: Data Recovery
text: Establish and maintain data recovery practices sufficient to restore in-scope enterprise assets to a pre-incident, trusted state.

title: Network Infrastructure Management
text: Establish, implement, and actively manage network devices to prevent attackers from exploiting vulnerable network services and access points.

title: Network Monitoring and Defense
text: Operate processes and tooling to establish and maintain comprehensive network monitoring and defense against security threats.

title: Security Awareness and Skills Training
text: Establish and maintain a security awareness program to influence workforce behavior in a security-conscious way, and build the specific skills needed by roles with elevated risk (developers, admins).

title: Service Provider Management
text: Develop a process to evaluate service providers that hold sensitive data or are responsible for critical IT platforms/processes, to ensure they are protecting those platforms and data appropriately.

title: Application Software Security
text: Manage the security lifecycle of in-house-developed, hosted, or acquired software to prevent, detect, and remediate security weaknesses before they can affect the enterprise.

title: Incident Response Management
text: Establish a program to develop and maintain an incident response capability (policies, plans, procedures, defined roles, training, communications) to prepare for, detect, and quickly respond to attacks.

title: Penetration Testing
text: Test the effectiveness and resilience of enterprise assets by identifying and exploiting weaknesses in controls (people, processes, technology), simulating an attacker's actions.
